test_cases.title: Applicant filters the search by three species and sees the union of their results
acs: DERIVED: Applicant filters the search by three species and sees the union of their results - features/species-filter/species-filter.feature:23

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as an SSO user using the current Windows session
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Open the Search Disease Profiles page with published, draft and scenario versions all ticked and the letter All
steps.expected: The Search Disease Profiles page is displayed with all three display options ticked

steps.action: Click Show filter by affected species
steps.expected: The affected species tree is displayed

steps.action: Tick Frogs and toads in the affected species tree
steps.expected: Frogs and toads is ticked

steps.action: Tick Birds - native and introduced - captive in the affected species tree
steps.expected: Birds - native and introduced - captive is ticked

steps.action: Tick Carp in the affected species tree
steps.expected: Carp is ticked

steps.action: Check the Currently selected text under the tree
steps.expected: It reads "Currently selected: Frogs and toads, Birds - native and introduced - captive, Carp"

steps.action: Click Search profiles
steps.expected: The results list and the count of disease profiles found are displayed

steps.action: Count the ticked species
steps.expected: 3 species are ticked

steps.action: Search for each of the three species on its own and compare counts
steps.expected: The combined count is at least the largest single count, at most their sum, and equals the count for the three species together

acs: DERIVED: Applicant combines a species with search text and gets no more than the species alone - features/species-filter/species-filter.feature:62

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as an SSO user using the current Windows session
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Open the Search Disease Profiles page with published, draft and scenario versions all ticked and the letter All
steps.expected: The Search Disease Profiles page is displayed with all three display options ticked

steps.action: Click Show filter by affected species
steps.expected: The affected species tree is displayed

steps.action: Tick Birds in the affected species tree
steps.expected: Birds is ticked

steps.action: Click Search profiles
steps.expected: The results list and the count of disease profiles found are displayed

steps.action: Note the count of disease profiles found
steps.expected: The count is noted

steps.expected: The results are reloaded for that text

steps.action: Compare the new count with the noted count
steps.expected: The new count is less than or equal to the noted count

steps.expected: 1 species is ticked
